integrity: Algebraic proof and exact finite-field multiplicity formula are self-contained; computational experiments are supporting checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-block flag only; no claim for longer flags.
Existence of a compatible inner inverse is established in arbitrary finite characteristic; direct checker enumerates only small prime fields.
Previously published block-regularity criteria are credited and not claimed as new.
Priority overlap remains possible because the full 2001 and 2020 papers were inaccessible.
title: A universal defect-rank law in two-block flag-preserving matrix monoids
